name: VCDS water recovery — 1979 reference case

source.title: Preprototype vapor compression distillation subsystem — NASA-CR-160332
source.location: Table 1 p.7 (PDF p.14); Table 4 p.17 (PDF p.24); Table 9 p.39 (PDF p.46)

derivations.feed_capacity_kg_day: Table 1 maximum total 18.1 kg/day minus 0.9 kg/day internal water-quality-monitor recycle = 17.2 kg/day external-feed design budget (also 12 + 3.4 + 1.8). Treated as a fixed modeled budget, not measured maximum throughput.
derivations.recovery_fraction: 0.90 is an explicit illustrative model yield, not a measured VCDS recovery. Do not infer yield from 9.3/10.2: the nominal feed table includes internal quality-monitor recycle, so those totals do not establish net recovery.
derivations.electrical_power_kw: Mechanical 171 W (Table 4, excludes instrumentation) + control/monitor 696 W (Table 9) = 867 W. Fixed installed load assumed while units are enabled.
derivations.hardware_mass_kg: Mechanical dry mass 143 kg (Table 4) + separate instrumentation 100 kg (Table 9) = 243 kg historical setup; not flight installation mass.

limitations: Historical preprototype reference case; planetary suitability and modern potable-water compliance are not established.
Feed budget comes from the design specification; recovery yield is an explicit 90% illustrative assumption. No validated throughput/yield curve is available for this selected case.

The original subsystem processes pretreated urine/flush water and brine, not every untreated habitat waste stream. Applying it to the simplified potable-use return stream is an unvalidated feed-compatibility assumption.
Pretreatment chemicals, heat rejection, startup/drydown, consumables, quality-control rejection and reliability are not modeled.
Power and mass include the historical separate instrumentation; modern replacements are not assumed.
Wastewater queue is ideal and unbounded; storage tank capacity and overflow are not evaluated.
